terminology.meaning: The thin OAT project a wave runs as; it adds ordering, isolation, gates and bookkeeping over an immutable external plan.
The five public packages whose versions must move together in one PR.
The wave-boundary re-derivation of a plan against current main before the lane starts.
The ceiling on review rounds for one scope, after which fixes must be reviewer-specified and root-verified.
The post-merge wrapper-project bookkeeping deferred to program close.
An explainer package whose immutable bytes are committed and verified against its manifest hashes.
